import json, sys, time, random, subprocess
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj

NSTATES = 4096
NTRANS = 16384
states = ["q%04d" % i for i in range(NSTATES)]
types = [
  {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": states},
  {"name": "Big", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f%d" % i, "U8"] for i in range(16)]},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Big", "size": 4},
]
modules = [{"name": "entry", "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"], ["blk", "Arr"]],
            "result": ["r", "U8"],
            "requires": ["all", "e", ["var", "blk"], ["lt", ["field", ["var", "e"], "f0"], ["const", "U8", 60000]]]}]
transitions = []
for i in range(NTRANS):
    transitions.append({"from": states[i % NSTATES], "to": states[(i * 7 + 3) % NSTATES],
                        "command": "c%03d" % (i % 900), "cost": 1 + (i % 9), "when": None})
for i in range(NSTATES - 1):   # cheap chain
    transitions[i] = {"from": states[i], "to": states[i + 1], "command": "a%03d" % (i % 900), "cost": 1,
                      "when": ["lt", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U8", 0]],
                               ["field", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U8", 0]], "f0"],
                               ["const", "U8", 60000]]}
machine = {"states": states, "initial": "q0000", "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": transitions}
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["entry"],
       "machine": machine, "runs": []}
json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json', 'w'))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json', 'rb'), capture_output=True)
plan = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())["plans"][0]
slots = plan["slots"]
print("variables", plan["variables"], "slots", len(slots))
names = [s[0] for s in slots]
widths = {s[0]: s[2] for s in slots}
runs = []
for k in range(2048):
    objs = []
    for name in names:
        if name == "x0":
            objs.append(obj(name, (k * 137) % NSTATES, 4))
        elif name == "x79":
            objs.append(obj(name, k % 60000, 2))
        elif name in ("x2", "x3", "x4"):
            objs.append(obj(name, 0x61 + (k % 20), 1))
        else:
            objs.append(obj(name, (k * 31 + int(name[1:])) % 60000, widths[name]))
    runs.append({"entry": "entry", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
doc["runs"] = runs
json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json', 'w'))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/scale.json', 'rb'), capture_output=True)
print("elapsed %.2fs rc=%d stderr=%s" % (time.time() - t, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:400]))
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print("corpus", len(out["corpus"]), "max commands", max((len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"]), default=0))
print("sample", json.dumps(out["corpus"][0])[:200] if out["corpus"] else None)
